articles.title: Fifa scraps World Cup investment plan after outcry
articles.description: Fifa boss Gianni Infantino said the project to sell off stakes in its major competitions had "created divisions" and would not go ahead.

articles.title: Labour's Bev Craig elected Greater Manchester mayor, succeeding Andy Burnham
articles.description: Labour's Bev Craig secures nearly double the number of votes won by Reform UK's Sian Astley.

articles.title: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
articles.description: Spain said most had returned to Morocco by Friday evening, as Italy suspended its Schengen agreement on free movement with Madrid.

articles.title: Police release Nancy Guthrie ransom notes in latest bid to find kidnappers
articles.description: Investigators hope the notes' "distinct linguistic characteristics" may be recognised by a member of the public.
